title: The people and the leader
goal: Look at the link between the leader and the people, and say who believes what, using creer que and no creer que.
grammar: Opinion verbs and mood: creer que, no creer que

items: I can describe how populist leaders spoke to the people.
I can say what benefits the movements gave to the workers.
I can explain why some historians doubt the direct link between leader and people.
I can say what the text says about trade unions and the press.
I can report what some historians believe and what others do not believe.
